data.long_meaning: The name नीरज (Nīraj) is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nīraja' which means 'shining upwards', 'radiant', 'brilliant', or 'pure light'. It is a term used to describe the supreme self or the absolute reality, symbolizing the eternal, unchanging, and infinite consciousness. The name नीरज carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining, Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose नीरज usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
